results.name: C2.4: Mass gap vanishes at u_3 = 3^(-3/8)
C2.5: Comparison of gap formulas across geometries at beta=2
results.details: K4 partition gap (chi=2,F=4): 6.0061, FCC intensive gap (chi=3,F=8): 13.1108, K4 transfer matrix (chi=4,F=10): 16.1139. All follow general formula -chi*ln(d_3) - F*ln(u_3). FCC has different chi/F ratio (3/8=0.375) vs K4 (2/5=0.4).

results.details: Verified m_gap = N_s * mu for N_s = 1, 2, 4, 8 at beta=2.0. mu = 13.110823. Linear scaling confirms extensive gap (volume-wide excitation).

results.name: C3.1: Critical condition u_3(beta_c) = 3^(-3/8) verified numerically

results.details: At beta_c = 11.421576447517191: lambda_3/lambda_1 = 1.000000 (should be 1.0). This is the deconfinement transition where the fundamental representation eigenvalue catches the trivial.

results.name: C3.3: Phase identification: confined (beta<beta_c) vs deconfined (beta>beta_c)
results.details: mu(beta_c - 0.5) = 0.1759 (> 0 => confined), mu(beta_c + 0.5) = -0.1594 (< 0 => deconfined). Sign change confirms deconfinement transition.

results.name: C3.4: Polyakov loop order parameter changes at beta_c
results.details: <|L|^2>(confined, L=10) = 1.0010 (expect ~1), <|L|^2>(deconfined, L=10) = 3.0391 (expect ~3). Confirms order parameter distinction between phases.

results.name: C3.5: Critical exponent nu = 1 (mean-field) from correlation length
results.details: Fitted nu = 1.133 (expected 1.0 for mean-field). Error = 0.133. xi(beta) = 1/mu(beta) ~ (beta_c - beta)^(-nu).
